harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (Alpine) and installed it as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates. Verified trust with openssl verify, then restarted node1, confirmed the boot identity changed, and re-verified the CA remained trusted after reboot.
actions_performed: Installed openssl and ca-certificates packages via apk (cmd-e66674237c93482d)
Generated 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 root CA cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE basicConstraints, keyCertSign/cRLSign keyUsage, 10-year validity (cmd-2f988f5a5274482e)
Copied cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and ran update-ca-certificates to install it as a trusted system CA (cmd-8f2e324ca845493d)
Verified trust anchor installation via symlink in /etc/ssl/certs/ and openssl verify against the system bundle (cmd-03d91b36ec28429d, cmd-8da76d111def474b, cmd-0a155fac029546f4)
Triggered native reboot on node1 via backgrounded 'reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect (cmd-338a57165abb4527)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned (multiple connection-reset/timeout attempts, then success at cmd-c3310167cefe4280)
Confirmed boot_id changed from fe65c36c-... to ce38fd82-... proving an actual restart occurred (cmd-cfa9823bc4074593, cmd-c3310167cefe4280)
Re-verified post-restart that the CA cert and its trust symlinks in /etc/ssl/certs/ persisted and openssl verify still returns OK (cmd-7bef9f020f3a4b53)

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: Generated rootCA.key and self-signed rootCA.crt with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE, valid 10 years

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Installed ca-certificates/openssl packages, copied cert into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates, ran update-ca-certificates; confirmed symlink ca763292.0 in /etc/ssl/certs and 2 matches (subject+issuer) for the CA CN inside the system ca-certificates.crt bundle

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before restart (CA trust functional)
evidence.summary: openssl verify -CAfile against system bundle returned OK for the root CA cert; captured pre-restart boot_id fe65c36c-7110-4d64-90f5-b869e659863e

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command via nohup/disown returned 'reboot scheduled' acknowledgement immediately, prior to the connection dropping on subsequent polls

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just downtime)
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is ce38fd82-b0e1-405c-9fc4-fcf41e93ea32, differing from the pre-restart boot_id fe65c36c-7110-4d64-90f5-b869e659863e, with uptime -s showing a fresh boot timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust state
evidence.summary: After reboot, /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and its /etc/ssl/certs symlinks (ca-cert-os-comparison-root-ca.pem, ca763292.0) are intact, and openssl verify -CAfile against the system bundle again returns OK
